description: Retrospective visit-level morphology analysis of pinned published K2-18 b GO-2372 spectra; no molecular attribution is evaluated.

program.selection_rule: Select every G395H visit in GO-2372 for which both archived Eureka and exoTEDRF NRS2 views are present; this selects C2 and C3 exactly.
program.note: Eureka and exoTEDRF are paired correlated views of each visit's photons, not independent evidence; cross-reduction z combination and voting are prohibited.

exoTEDRF.uncertainty_rule: max(yerrLow,yerrUpp), with both reported errors required positive

Eureka.uncertainty_rule: 1000000*max(rp^2_errorneg,rp^2_errorpos), with both reported errors required positive
Eureka.unit_note: The table omits ECSV unit tags; field names and value scale identify wavelength in micrometres and rp-squared as a fraction. Validation rejects values outside the frozen physical scale.

rebinning.grid_definition: e_k = 1 micrometre * exp(k/100) for integer k
rebinning.edge_hash_encoding: newline-joined Python float64 format(.17g), no trailing newline
rebinning.assignment: For each output row j, W_ji is proportional to overlap_length(native_i,output_j)/sigma_i^2 and normalized so the used row sums to 1; y_out=W*y_native and every assumed covariance is propagated as C_out=W*C_native*W^T
rebinning.overlap_invariant: W_ji must be exactly zero when native interval i has zero overlap with output interval j; a native row may contribute to multiple non-overlapping output bins only in proportion to its actual interval overlap
rebinning.edge_policy: use only global cells wholly inside 3.85-4.75 micrometres and wholly covered by native NRS2 cells; reject rather than clip partial cells

analysis.label: 4.3-micrometre morphology
analysis.model: y = alpha + beta*(lambda-4.30) + A*f, where f is the output-bin wavelength-overlap fraction with [4.05,4.55] micrometres
analysis.primary_covariance: C_native=diag(max(error_low,error_high)^2), with both errors positive; C_out=W*C_native*W^T; fit by full GLS
analysis.ar1_scope: C_native_ij=sigma_i*sigma_j*rho^abs(i-j) within NRS2, propagated as W*C_native*W^T and fit by full GLS
analysis.leave_one_output_bin_out: refit the full intercept+slope+feature model with the corresponding covariance row and column removed; any invalid fit fails closed

outcome_rules.repeatable_positive_morphology: all four nominal cells exist and are valid with A>0 and z>=2, every rho sensitivity is valid with A>0, every one-bin-deletion fit is valid with A>0, and no cell or required diagnostic is missing or failed
outcome_rules.SCIENCE_UNRESOLVED: criterion_not_met for every other result; no all-abs(z)-below-2 state is defined

combination_rules.within_reduction: fixed common effect and Cochran Q across visit_2 and visit_3 only
combination_rules.paired_reduction_difference: Eureka-minus-exoTEDRF amplitude per visit, without significance because cross-reduction covariance is unavailable

allowed_claim: The harness reports whether the signed 4.3-micrometre morphology in the pinned published GO-2372 spectra is repeatable across the two visits and stable across two correlated reductions under the frozen diagnostics; molecular attribution is not evaluated.
prohibited_claims: independent evidence from Eureka and exoTEDRF
